title: Yekatit 12 massacre in Addis Ababa
note: Three-day reprisal massacre of thousands of Ethiopian civilians and intelligentsia in Addis Ababa ordered by Rodolfo Graziani following an assassination attempt on 19 February 1937 (Yekatit 12 in the Ethiopian calendar).

title: Haile Selassie
note: Emperor of Ethiopia (1930–1974) who led national resistance against Italian fascist invasion, delivered the historic 1936 address to the League of Nations denouncing chemical warfare, and became an anti-colonial symbol across Africa.

title: Second Italo-Ethiopian War
note: Fascist Italy's aggressive war of colonial conquest against the Ethiopian Empire, marked by widespread aerial deployment of prohibited mustard gas and the breakdown of League of Nations collective security.

title: Assassination of Giacomo Matteotti
note: Abduction and murder of socialist deputy Giacomo Matteotti by fascist squadrists following his parliamentary speech exposing fascist election violence, precipitating the crisis that led to Mussolini's 1925 dictatorial coup.
